narrative.overview:
The site reads like the results and appendix of a systematic review. Reviewers come to check claims, so every claim sits next to its interval, its recorded run, or its status mark. The world lives in the frame and the apparatus: a plum masthead rule, booktabs tables, forest plots, numbered figures and one numbered equation. The reading column stays calm, set in a serif at a real measure on white paper.

Bad news gets the same typographic weight as good news. A result that favours the single agent is plotted the same way as one that favours the team. A "missing" status gets the same mark anatomy as a "matches".
keyCharacteristics: White paper, near-black ink, one plum accent, warm grey hairlines.
Serif for reading and headings; humanist sans for the apparatus; mono only for code and identifiers.
Rules, not boxes. There are no cards, panels or shadows.
Data devices: forest plots, four-dot status marks and booktabs tables.

rules.name: The One Plum Rule
rules.body: Plum is the only accent. A second hue never carries meaning; status and correctness are told by dot count, weight and wash, with the word always printed.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Identifiers Rule
rules.body: Commit ids, run codes (f14, f15) and file names are set in Source Code Pro. Prose identifiers get no background; only real code gets the code ground.

rules.name: The Rules-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: Group content with horizontal rules and white space. A bordered, rounded or shadowed panel is not part of this world.

dos: **Do** put the comparison a reviewer came for (arms with intervals) directly under the Bottom line.
**Do** number every figure and table, and cite them from the prose.
**Do** print the status word next to every status mark, and the count next to every percentage.
**Do** state "Research prototype. Not for clinical use." in the masthead and the colophon of every page.
donts: **Don't** add cards, panels, shadows, rounded containers or a dark theme. The incumbent dark dashboard of rounded panels is the anti-reference.
**Don't** add a second accent colour or encode meaning by hue alone.
**Don't** use coloured side stripes (left or right borders over 1px, or inset shadows) to mark an active or current item.
**Don't** set prose or headings in mono.
